# locker { #gambeta.locker }

`locker`

Parquet read/write with schema validation and provenance manifests.

The Parquet store is the seam of the project: ingestion writes it, and every
downstream consumer reads it. Nothing past this module touches the network,
so a broken scraper breaks ingestion rather than analysis.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [manifest_path](#gambeta.locker.manifest_path) | Return the sidecar manifest path for a Parquet file. |
| [read](#gambeta.locker.read) | Read a Parquet file and validate it against ``schema``. |
| [write](#gambeta.locker.write) | Validate ``df``, write it to ``path``, and emit a provenance manifest. |

### manifest_path { #gambeta.locker.manifest_path }

```python
locker.manifest_path(path)
```

Return the sidecar manifest path for a Parquet file.

### read { #gambeta.locker.read }

```python
locker.read(path, schema)
```

Read a Parquet file and validate it against ``schema``.

### write { #gambeta.locker.write }

```python
locker.write(df, path, schema, source, extra=None)
```

Validate ``df``, write it to ``path``, and emit a provenance manifest.

Validation happens before any file is created, so a rejected frame never
leaves a partial artifact behind. A partial scrape must always be
distinguishable from a complete one. That is the manifest's real job.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                                    | Default    |
|--------|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| df     | pd.DataFrame             | Frame to persist.                                              | _required_ |
| path   | Path                     | Destination ``.parquet`` path. Parent directories are created. | _required_ |
| schema | pa.DataFrameSchema       | Schema the frame must satisfy.                                 | _required_ |
| source | str                      | Provenance label, e.g. ``"fbref"``.                            | _required_ |
| extra  | dict\[str, Any\] \| None | Additional key-value pairs to record in the manifest.          | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description       |
|--------|--------|-------------------|
|        | Path   | The path written. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                         | Description                                                |
|--------|------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | gambeta.laws.ValidationError | If ``df`` does not satisfy ``schema``. No file is written. |
